sloka: भजन्त्येते यथा काममश्वानारुह्य शीघ्रगान् ।एते भ्राजन्ति संहृष्टा गजानारुह्य सादिन: ॥ २.९६.१९॥
transliteration: bhajantyete yathā kāmamaśvānāruhya śīghragān ।ete bhrājanti saṁhṛṣṭā gajānāruhya sādina: ॥ 2.96.19॥

translations.english: There the emblem of the great Kovidara tree of very large trunk spread with many branches shines brilliantly atop the chariot.
